note: Placeholder sources in the generic cases must be bound before a run; case 10 is already bound to a real body-text comparison. Listing a case does not mean it has been run or passed; behavioural evidence comes from the actual answers of an independent evaluation.

evals.prompt: Use ljg-paper to read this method paper <source_path> and save the Org note and the paper-map.
evals.expected_output: The reader understands the research question, the new method, the comparison conditions and the limits of the conclusion.
assertions: the first two sections state the research question and the main contribution
it explains how the key steps change the result
it keeps the comparison conditions and counterexamples that affect the conclusion
with a unified mechanism, an independent reader can use it to explain two different findings; without one, the relations are explained separately
the necessary roles and actions are distinguished before the method's rules are explained; the example shows conditions, actions and consequences

evals.prompt: Read this paper proposing a new benchmark <source_path> and save the Org note and the paper-map.
evals.expected_output: It says what the new benchmark separates and which causes remain unexplained.
assertions: it separates a measurement contribution from a causal explanation
it says which difference the old metric missed
necessary supplementary comparisons are kept by what they tell us
leaderboard performance is not equated with real-world capability
it states what is measured and how the comparison works, without relying on the evaluator to supply field background

evals.prompt: Read this theoretical paper <source_path> and save the Org note and the paper-map.
evals.expected_output: It explains the assumptions, the relations, the different inferences and the conditions of application.
assertions: where there is no comparative experiment, it states the form of argument honestly
with a unified mechanism, it uses it to explain two different findings
it separates predictions about changed conditions from validated conclusions
it invents no mechanism for material that lacks a unified explanation
concepts and assumptions needed to follow the inference are explained in place, with no forced story opening or experiment structure

evals.prompt: Read this system or resource paper <source_path> and save the Org note and the paper-map.
evals.expected_output: It states the new capability, the key components, and the cost, speed or scale limits.
assertions: it states the actual contribution and what prior work lacked
it keeps several performance and cost comparisons as needed
it explains what different information each comparison provides
an engineering contribution is not inflated into a general theory

evals.prompt: Read this paper with several research questions <source_path> and save the Org note and the paper-map.
evals.expected_output: Every necessary thread is covered, and cases may change while independent experiments sit side by side.
assertions: the research record covers every necessary thread and its evidential status
the body explains how the threads connect
where sections can be swapped, it says they are parallel
no causal link is invented to manufacture progression
cases with similar jobs may coexist when they provide different information

evals.prompt: Rewrite the old draft <draft_path> against the original paper <source_path>. The reader says they cannot tell what the paper studies or what the authors did.
evals.expected_output: The research question, the main contribution and the explanatory process are restored in place.
assertions: the original file, source and identifier are preserved
missing content is supplied before the wording is polished
it uses plain language and completes the subject, verb and object relations
the body is not organized around the research record's field names

evals.prompt: Rewrite the old draft <draft_path> against the original paper <source_path>. The reader can only remember a string of scores and cannot say why the experiments were run that way.
evals.expected_output: The content is reorganized by what the evidence does, and the reader understands the reasons behind the results.
assertions: the check is not evaded by splitting paragraphs or spelling numbers out in words
necessary differences and counterexamples are kept, with no forced single kind of result
the script's number hint does not by itself judge the quality of the writing
if the independent reading check still only recites scores, it fails

evals.prompt: Explain this paper <source_path> directly, without saving any file.
evals.expected_output: It stays within the scope of a spoken explanation and still gives the contribution, the change of understanding, the reasons behind the results and the limits.
assertions: it does not require generating the Org note or the paper-map
it runs no file checks and fabricates no passing result
digits inside a method name do not affect the whole-text paraphrase check
when no independent evaluation is possible, it says so honestly

evals.prompt: Read this observational study with no unified mechanism <source_path> and save the Org note and the paper-map.
evals.expected_output: It explains the different findings and their relations, preserving the distinction between correlation and causation.
assertions: it forces neither a dramatic reversal nor a unified formula
it says how the findings jointly form the contribution
invented examples are naturally distinguished from the paper's experiments
source verification and the four independent reading checks are kept

evals.prompt: Assess how self-sufficient the two same-source paper readings in plain-language-pair.json are for a reader with no field background. The evaluator receives only reader and candidates, with expected, the version order and past feedback hidden; paraphrase one actual process for each and map it onto the paper's roles, then choose the more understandable one and quote specific sentences for the reason.
evals.expected_output: It can tell a paraphrase of jargon apart from an imaginable course of action, and can check whether an everyday scene preserves the paper's identity; it compares from the actual post-reading answers rather than voting by a preset label.
assertions: expected, the version order and past feedback stay hidden during assessment; only the target reader and the candidate bodies are provided
one actual process is paraphrased for each and mapped onto the paper's objects, rather than judging plainness by term count or labels
it quotes the sentences that require field knowledge and names the missing role, purpose or connection
the paper's contribution and boundaries are preserved, and a fluent everyday story does not pass automatically
a missing necessary premise is a NARRATIVE_FAIL even when the evaluator could paraphrase from their own knowledge
an independent comparison is not proof that a real non-specialist understood it; later user feedback can overturn the automatic verdict

evals.prompt: Use ljg-paper to explain the original paper at https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.03172v3 directly, without saving a user note. At evaluation time supply the full PDF or an identical full text; save the body temporarily for an independent trial reading.
evals.expected_output: Without relying on an earlier paper's scene or conclusions, it explains this benchmark paper with the current skill, and an independent reader can paraphrase the actual experiment, the findings and the limits.
assertions: field objects and actions appearing for the first time are explained for an ordinary reader
both task threads and the important comparisons each do a job, rather than reciting an overall score
measurement findings stay distinct from causal explanation, with no manufactured unified mechanism
no story is forced; the actual process and the scope of the conclusion can be explained
the independent evaluation reads only the generated body, source checking happens separately, and no PASS is pre-filled before a run
